def stack(parts, k):

def prefills(parts, align):
    X = []
    L = []
    S = []
    for q in parts:
        xr = q['coupon_features_raw'].copy()
        labs = q['lab_id']
        refs = q['ref_coupons']
        for l in np.unique(labs):
            sel = labs == l
            R = refs[sel] if align == 'local' else np.vstack([p['ref_coupons'][p['lab_id'] == l] for p in parts])
            xr[sel] = (xr[sel] - np.median(R.mean(0))) / np.median(R.std(0))
        X.append(xr)
        L.extend(labs)
        S.extend(q['stratum'])
    return (np.vstack(X), np.asarray(L), np.asarray(S))
